Cabbage Patch Kids - Adventures in the P.name: Cabbage Patch Kids: Adventures in the Park
Cabbage Patch Kids - Adventures in the P.summary: Cabbage Patch Kids: Adventures in the Park is a 1984 action/platform game based on the Cabbage Patch Kids franchise. It is the first and only game in the Cabbage Patch Kids Adventures Series

Night Driver.name: Night Driver
Night Driver.summary: Port of the Night Driver arcade game with added color visuals and a changed third person perspective.

Nuts.name: Nuts
Nuts.summary: You’re a hard working Squirrel. All year you’ve been storing food in your treetop home. Suddenly, when you’re away, the Wily Weasel steals it all. Don’t let him get away with it! Throw nuts at him!. Knock him off the branch! Recover your goodies! It’s exciting! It’s crazy! It’s NUTS! It’ll drive you right out of your tree!

RealSports Basketball.name: RealSports Basketball
RealSports Basketball.summary: RealSports Basketball was an unreleased prototype developed by Atari, which would have filled out Atari's RealSports lineup nicely (Baseball, Football, Soccer, Tennis, and Volleyball titles were released). This version of the game is about 90% complete and fully playable. A version of this game with box, manual, and cartridge was sold at the 2002 Classic Gaming Expo.
